title: Typed Multi-Packet Hydrology Provider and Forcing Lifecycle
candidate_claim: An immutable collection of complete KT05 explicit hydrology packets can deterministically select exactly one packet from a bounded whole-day KT02 requested interval, remain stateless across repeated requests, fail closed on missing or duplicate interval keys, and delegate the selected packet through admitted KT06 without changing KT02 time, accepted-state or publication ownership.
implemented_semantics: exact endpoint plus duration packet key
duplicate packet interval key rejected at initialization
storage order has no semantic effect
provider owns a deep copy; caller mutation after initialization cannot alter selection or forcing
same interval may be selected repeatedly without consuming forcing
selected complete packet delegates through frozen KT06
forcing remains outside accepted continuation state
public packet count is zero for a provider that failed initialization
tests: three-packet private interval reaches exact target
missing middle packet cannot externally publish partial interval
same endpoint with different durations remains two distinct exact interval keys
caller-owned source mutation after initialization cannot alter provider
eight representative real LWKM anchor packets bind
